responsibilities: Design, build, and maintain reusable data models and reporting datasets.
Integrate data from multiple systems and resolve differences in identifiers, classifications, formats, and business definitions.
Partner with business stakeholders to translate reporting needs into clear metrics and data requirements.
Develop and maintain Power BI semantic models, measures, relationships, and reporting logic to ensure consistent calculations.
Build automated processes for data preparation and quality checks, including accuracy, completeness, consistency, and freshness.
Manage late-arriving data, corrections, and historical changes while maintaining data traceability.
Improve query performance, data reliability, and usability.
Implement approved data access controls and row-level security where required.
Document data models, metric definitions, source relationships, and transformation logic.
Collaborate with data engineers and analysts to deliver maintainable solutions and troubleshoot production data issues.
Use AI-assisted tools responsibly for development, testing, documentation, and analysis — while critically reviewing and validating the outputs.

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Build automated processes for data preparation and quality checks, including accuracy, completeness, consistency, and freshness.
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Accuracy, completeness, freshness, traceability, testing and controlled deployment run through the whole posting, with no speed or shipping language at all.
evidence.domain_risk: scalable reporting models that support sales, product performance, and inventory decisions
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: A consumer skincare brand where the numbers drive sales and inventory decisions — real commercial consequence, but no regulatory or financial-reporting exposure.
evidence.data_team_maturity: Collaborate with data engineers and analysts to deliver maintainable solutions and troubleshoot production data issues.
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: Separate data engineers and analysts already exist alongside production data models, but there are no named sub-teams or scale signals.
evidence.jd_authorship: Develop and maintain Power BI semantic models, measures, relationships, and reporting logic to ensure consistent calculations.
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Bullets name DAX, filter context, row-level security, late-arriving data and traceability — the actual daily problems, not generic stakeholder work.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: trusted datasets, consistent business metrics, and scalable reporting models that support sales, product performance, and inventory decisions
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The named decisions are sales, product performance and inventory — commercial operations rather than the data function or a product team.
evidence.autonomy_level: Can reconcile different stakeholder requirements and help establish shared definitions and trusted metrics.
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role establishes shared metric definitions and takes ownership, but most bullets are scoped delivery against reporting needs translated from stakeholders.
evidence.ai_role: You'll also have the opportunity to use AI tools and agents to improve development, testing, documentation, and analysis, while applying sound judgment to validate AI-generated outputs.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: AI is the candidate's own tool for coding, testing and documentation, with a responsibility bullet and a requirement about judging its output.
evidence.testing_framing: Takes ownership of data quality and proactively identifies issues before they impact reporting.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Quality checks are something the candidate builds and owns, stated in both responsibilities and the mindset section.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: ensure that the numbers used for decision-making are accurate, consistent, and easy to trust
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Trust in the numbers is the role's stated purpose in the opening section, so the fear is bad data reaching decision-makers.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Design, build, and maintain reusable data models and reporting datasets.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: Building new models sits alongside integrating and reconciling an existing multi-system estate.
evidence.language_gate: Professional English proficiency, both written and spoken.
evidence.loss_aversion: "proactively ensures data reliability — not someone who waits to be chased when something breaks" — the posting names the failure mode it is hiring against.
